in_arabic.name: ناظرة
in_arabic.long_meaning: ناظرة هي اسم مؤنث مشتق من الفعل 'نَظَرَ' الذي يعني النظر أو المراقبة. في اللغة العربية، يعني الاسم الشخص الذي يراقب أو يحافظ على شيء ما. وفي القرآن الكريم، لا يوجد ذكر صريح للاسم ولكن الفعل 'نَظَرَ' ورد في عدة آيات، منها قوله تعالى: 'وَيَنظُرُونَ إِلَيكَ أَيُّهُمُ الْمَفْتُونُ' (القلم: 6). تاريخياً، استخدم الاسم في الثقافة العربية الإسلامية للإشارة إلى الشخص الذي يتصف بالمراقبة والانتباه.

in_urdu.name: ناظرہ
in_urdu.meaning: مراقبہ کرنے والی، نگاہ رکھنے والی، محافظ
in_urdu.long_meaning: ناظرہ ایک مؤنث نام ہے جو عربی زبان کے فعل 'نَظَرَ' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے دیکھنا یا مراقبہ کرنا۔ اردو میں، اس نام کا معنی ہے وہ شخص جو مراقبہ کرتا ہے یا کسی چیز پر نگاہ رکھتا ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمان روایت میں، یہ نام احتیاط اور محافظت کی صفات کے ساتھ منسلک ہے۔

in_hindi.name: नाज़िरा
in_hindi.meaning: देखने वाली, निगरानी करने वाली, रक्षक
in_hindi.long_meaning: नाज़िरा एक स्त्रीलिंग नाम है जो अरबी भाषा के क्रिया 'नज़र' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है देखना या निगरानी करना। हिंदी में, इस नाम का अर्थ है वह व्यक्ति जो देखती है या किसी चीज़ पर निगरानी रखती है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम सावधानी और रक्षात्मकता की विशेषताओं से जुड़ा है।

in_english.name: Naazirah
in_english.long_meaning: Naazirah is a feminine given name derived from the Arabic verb 'nathara', meaning to look or observe. In Islamic tradition, the name signifies a person who is watchful or observant. The root 'n-th-r' appears in the Quran, such as in Surah Al-Qalam (68:6), highlighting the act of looking or observing. Historically, the name Naazirah has been used across Muslim cultures to denote someone with vigilant and protective qualities.

data.cultural_impact: The name Naazirah holds significant cultural meaning as it represents guardianship and protection, which is an essential aspect of Islamic tradition. In Muslim societies, the importance of having a guardian or protector, particularly for women and children, is highly valued. The name Naazirah signifies the idea of being watched over or protected by a trusted figure, such as a parent, relative, or community member. Furthermore, the name may reflect the belief that individuals should be prepared to serve as guardians or protectors to others in their community, upholding Islamic values of compassion, kindness, and duty.
data.spiritual_significance: On a spiritual level, the name Naazirah carries profound importance as it is a reminder of the role of Allah as the ultimate Guardian and Protector in our lives. In Islamic tradition, Allah is referred to as "Al-Razzaq," the Provider, and "Al-Hafiz," the Preserver. By giving the name Naazirah to a child, parents may be conveying their faith that Allah is responsible for their child's wellbeing, and that they will trust in Allah's protection and guidance throughout their child's life. Additionally, the name may inspire the individual to serve as a guardian and protector of their own spiritual growth, striving to follow Allah's guidance and maintain a strong connection to their faith.
